items.title: Hunter Henry: Present for Friday's practice
items.text:
Henry (foot) is present for the media-access portion of Friday's practice, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Provides medical update Friday
items.text:
In a statement posted to social media on Friday, Henderson -- who hasn't practiced since last Wednesday -- noted that he recently experienced "an unexpected and unusual medical emergency involving a series of unexplained neurological symptoms," Mike Reiss of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Emeka Egbuka: Looks ready for Sunday
items.text:
Egbuka (foot) has been "full go" at practice and doesn't appear to have had any setbacks ahead of Sunday's matchup with the Bears, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jacoby Brissett: Joins Baltimore via trade
items.text:
The Ravens acquired Brissett and a 2027 fifth-round pick from the Cardinals on Friday in exchange for a 2027 fourth-round pick and a 2028 seventh-round pick, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Garrett Wilson: Ruled out for Sunday
items.text:
Wilson (concussion) is out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
